rounds.text: Dhariwalcorp Ltd trades below its intrinsic value at a market price of ₹31.5 against a discounted cash flow intrinsic value of ₹39, leaving a margin of safety of 19.3% [E2, E35, E36]. The company displays exceptional profitability expansion, evidenced by a 3-year compounded profit growth of 143% and a trailing twelve months profit growth of 141% [E14, E15]. Furthermore, return metrics comfortably exceed sector benchmarks, with an ROE of 14% to 17.9% compared to a sector median of 9.15%, and an ROCE reaching up to 22.1% against a sector benchmark of 11.51% [E8, E9, E10, E11]. The balance sheet remains on a conservative footing with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.13x, while borrowings have successfully decreased from ₹11 Cr to ₹8 Cr alongside a significant 133.3% surge in capital work-in-progress to ₹7 Cr indicating active growth investments [E28, E29, E30]. Institutional interest is validating this momentum, reflected by domestic institutions increasing their stake by 4.05 percentage points and generating a positive institutional money flow signal [E33, E34], all supported by a strong sectoral tailwind in chemicals [E52, E54]. Conceded: operating cash flow is negative at ₹-1 Cr alongside weak cash conversion and a promoter holding decrease [E24, E25, E31].
